name: Maren
text: Hello, traveler.
You don't see many strangers around here these days.
Safe travels out there. Watch the treeline after dark.
I have nothing more to say.
Thanks!
Let's do it.
Tell me more.
I like your beard.
Do you want to trade?

name: Tobin
description: A wanderer resting by the fire
text: Well met, traveler. I’ve been resting my feet by this fire.
I know these roads — the peaks, the wood, the dunes, the mire. Been walking them alone too long, if I’m honest.
Ha — I thought you’d never ask. Aye, I’m with you. I’ll wait at your fire till you’re ready to move.
And to you. I’ll be here a while yet.
Walk them with me, then. Join my party.
Safe travels.
What would you like to trade?
What have you brought me?
Yes... and what would you like in return?
Oh, how generous of you.
Some of these I can't take.
I've no use for any of that.
Changed your mind?
That'll cost you.
That's not a good deal.
That seems fair.
Yes, that's very generous!
Empty that sack first.
Nothing to trade.
That trade isn't worth my while.
Pleasure doing business.
Pleasure doing business — and please, take this as well.
You haven't offered anything.
I have nothing of value to give you in return.
I cannot accept any of these.
Thank you so much, here's a gift for you!
Some of these I can't accept, but thank you for the rest.
Thank you, this means a lot.
